questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I chose my study destination because I wanted to experience new cultures and nature while still being able to do well academically.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I had some personal issues which made my study abroad experience less succesfull

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I found it very difficult to get information about my subjects and how I should register

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I did not receive any assistance after I arrived

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: I found that there were many different IT-systems which were difficult to navigate in and it was hard finding out where I could get help

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was easy to find campus housing but it was very expensive and not very nice

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Sydney is very expensive and it is very difficult to find good housing. I recommend to start searching once you arrived as the market is very quick

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Se earliere comments

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It involved several steps: 1. Activate account, 2. Plan subjects, 3. Login to MySR, 4. Check personal details, 5. Register to class using the Allocate+ System

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There were som counsellors but they were very hard to reach as they did not reply to emails but only using specifics form which were hard to find

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I registered in the subjects I most liked but did not get the classes I would have liked

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't stress about it. I began looking at subjects way to early

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I noticed that the academic standards weren’t as high as at the University of Copenhagen. We didn’t read as many academic texts and weren’t very critical of what we did read.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Se earliere answer. One positive thing was that we had many assessments during the semester, and we got feedback on them, which was really helpful.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Sustainable Futures
Political Economy of Development
Politics of Sex and Gender
Politics, Power and Resistance

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend Politics of Sex and Gender. It was the most interesting of the ones I had and the teacher was very engaging
